remarks:
Welcome to this beautifully maintained home tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the highly sought-after Ransom Oaks neighborhood in East Amherst and Williamsville Central School District. Set on a professionally landscaped lot with a wooded backdrop, this home offers the perfect blend of thoughtful updates, functional living space, and the exceptional lifestyle that comes with living in one of Western New York's most desirable communities.

The remodeled kitchen features granite countertops, white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and opens seamlessly to the dining area and spacious family room, complete with a vaulted ceiling, skylight, cozy fireplace, and sliding glass doors leading to a concrete patio overlooking the private backyard. A formal living room adds additional space for entertaining or relaxing.

The finished basement expands your living area with a versatile recreation space, updated flooring (2025), and a convenient half bath.

Recent improvements provide added peace of mind, including LeafGuard gutters (2025), a new garage door and insulated man door (2025), some first-floor replacement windows (2025), a beautifully renovated full bathroom with brand new shower (2025), an updated sump pump (2025), and new basement flooring (2025).

Additional highlights include central air conditioning, recessed lighting, a 2.5-car attached garage, and a beautifully maintained exterior.

As a resident of Ransom Oaks, you'll enjoy access to outstanding neighborhood amenities, including multiple swimming pools, tennis and pickleball courts, playgrounds, walking paths, a clubhouse, and beautifully maintained green spaces.

Move right in and enjoy an updated home in an established neighborhood that's known for its amenities, convenience, and strong sense of community.
